skill_coefficients.derivation: UESP-calculated coefficient view derived from minedSkills tooltip observations.
notes: The documentation revision identifies the source documentation only; it is not the coefficient dataset version.
The export does not provide a reliable ESO game-update stamp, API version, or retrieval timestamp.
Numeric ability IDs are source crosswalk identifiers, not canonical BFF skill identities.
